IMUSA 4-Cup Espresso/Cappuccino Maker, Black
products.description: Get a morning cup ready with this IMUSA espresso maker. The unit offers a milk frother to help make cappuccinos, lattes and more, and has a 4-cup capacity. 4-cup coffee maker carafe offers a generous capacity. Stainless-steel drip tray is removable for simple cleaning. 5 Bar working pressure is great for a rich tasting brew. Variable steam control and milk frother make this unit great as a cappuccino maker and even help make lattes. 3-way selector knob enables simple use. Light indicators let you know when its on.
